09558b0.speaker: Treble
09558b0.line: it's one of those at least

0d9f94a.speaker: Beat
0d9f94a.line: What the hell happened to staying put while we surveyed the area?

0a3d67e.speaker: Clef
0a3d67e.line: This place is HUGE, what the hell.

071f117.speaker: Beat
071f117.line: How did you even get over there?

04ca75a.speaker: Beat
04ca75a.line: Uh, okay. Nobody said you were, dude.

0d394e7.speaker: Beat
0d394e7.line: That's almost as big of a jump as, well, this.

006be22.speaker: Quaver
006be22.line: There's nothing wrong with it either, Clef!

0503cc7.speaker: Quaver
0503cc7.line: Some people feel really badly about their weight and they shouldn't!

0b56c1f.speaker: Clef
0b56c1f.line: Not because I am, because...I'm not!

0d8073f.speaker: Treble
0d8073f.line: i mean, the rope overhead did snap like the second she stepped on,

0b3a926.speaker: Treble
0b3a926.line: we made it over here but we absolutely cannot make it back.

0ced156.speaker: Beat
0ced156.line: I'll see if I can find anything.

0379747.speaker: Beat
0379747.line: You've gotten really good at disappearing lately.

01092d8.speaker: Beat
01092d8.line: Been putting my foot in my mouth all day.

0ef3fa9.speaker: Beat
0ef3fa9.line: ...I'll shut up. I'm being an idiot.

0b25e05.speaker: Beat
0b25e05.line: Hope you're okay with being found.

0d05a15.speaker: Beat
0d05a15.line: I'm still sorry for being a lot lately.

043d160.speaker: Beat
043d160.line: ...I was kind of worried when I couldn't find you, you know.

0de820a.speaker: Quaver
0de820a.line: ...my mom used to say "no make" all the time.

01ae1f9.speaker: Quaver
01ae1f9.line: You know how you're not supposed to want to know how a sausage is made?

080da86.speaker: Beat
080da86.line: I think I kind of get it.

05db0bb.speaker: Quaver
05db0bb.line: Right, it's like...don't let people see you put the work in.

0c48335.speaker: Quaver
0c48335.line: If you hide the work, everything you do seems like a magic trick.

07e169e.speaker: Quaver
07e169e.line: I'm happy I know how much work you put in, Beat.

0c9c5e4.speaker: Beat
0c9c5e4.line: Don't turn my apology into your apology!

0017709.speaker: Quaver
0017709.line: I don't get it at all.

0ad20a3.speaker: Beat
0ad20a3.line: Anyone'd be lucky to be stuck with you.

09ec195.speaker: Quaver
09ec195.line: I don't want people to feel like they're "stuck with me" at all.

06190f8.speaker: Quaver
06190f8.line: I'm sorry if it is. I'm irritated.

02fa11d.speaker: Quaver
02fa11d.line: I'm not mad at you but I'm not in a good mood at all.

0f542ab.speaker: Unknown
0f542ab.line: There's not really much to get.

0374f78.speaker: Quaver
0374f78.line: Is that supposed to make me feel better?

09ee651.speaker: Beat
09ee651.line: It would make me feel better.

0e2fdf2.speaker: Quaver
0e2fdf2.line: I'm not in the mood for these kinds of jokes, Beat.

06df7f7.speaker: Beat
06df7f7.line: I don't actually think that way.

0153846.speaker: Beat
0153846.line: ...You make it really easy to forget I'm talking to a twelve-year-old.

0ff99ad.speaker: Waitress
0ff99ad.line: Well, yeah. It's all we got.

04a5cc3.speaker: Beat
04a5cc3.line: Just one soup on the menu?

0f2ebfa.speaker: Waitress
0f2ebfa.line: Plenty of soups. Just not plenty of broths.

0129dba.speaker: Waitress
0129dba.line: Everything here swims in the same stuff.

08d03e9.speaker: Waitress
08d03e9.line: Unfortunately we only serve tonkotsu ramen here.

0ee54d8.speaker: Beat
0ee54d8.line: I mean, yeah. Anything else isn't really ramen.

0f0df59.speaker: Beat
0f0df59.line: Look, Quaver. It's not the end of the world.

0f5b9a7.speaker: Beat
0f5b9a7.line: It's not! You can form another band.

0210f7a.speaker: Quaver
0210f7a.line: Even people who are okay with us doing this aren't gonna want to go to jail.

07b386a.speaker: Beat
07b386a.line: We found Treble and Clef easily enough. There's gotta be more Treble and Clefs-

05fed4a.speaker: Quaver
05fed4a.line: ...I just want to eat my soup, if that's okay.

051767e.speaker: Beat
051767e.line: You can eat while I help you feel better.

066b69a.speaker: Beat
066b69a.line: Come on. I just want to help-

05ec193.speaker: Quaver
05ec193.line: Isn't that what we're supposed to say?

05e6437.speaker: Apoco
05e6437.line: She was talking to the little kid.

0affd48.speaker: Beat
0affd48.line: I don't even know who you two are.

05656f1.speaker: Poco
05656f1.line: God, sis. She doesn't even know us.

06e5c84.speaker: Poco
06e5c84.line: We should educate you. The name is

0a2dce1.speaker: Apoco
0a2dce1.line: Well, you ruined the introduction. Are you happy?

00a6823.speaker: Quaver
00a6823.line: How could I ever be unhappy to see you two?

06b68ee.speaker: Apoco
06b68ee.line: Did you learn sarcasm? That's new for you.

05a8bf3.speaker: Poco
05a8bf3.line: That might be your influence, Pink Hair.

0de8a33.speaker: Apoco
0de8a33.line: Fun like a desk toy is fun.

0cb1ab0.speaker: Apoco
0cb1ab0.line: Though not really much about you. Which is.

0668100.speaker: Poco
0668100.line: But is there anything to know?

00e19bf.speaker: Quaver
00e19bf.line: Just get this over with. I'm not in the mood.

07ff88c.speaker: Beat
07ff88c.line: Don't talk to her like that!

0e3acd1.speaker: Quaver
0e3acd1.line: Put the handcuffs on us already.

09d4134.speaker: Poco
09d4134.line: Actually, we came here to tell you we're going to do nothing to you.

041615c.speaker: Poco
041615c.line: All of this will fade away and you'll have done nothing but make our boss mad.

001ac2f.speaker: Beat
001ac2f.line: So, what, you spent all your time and money and energy and it's just...over?

0f190c5.speaker: Apoco
0f190c5.line: That's a dumbass way to look at it.

0f0bb33.speaker: Poco
0f0bb33.line: Nobody will care what happened to you by tomorrow night's news. You're irrelevant.

02e30d4.speaker: Quaver
02e30d4.line: I just...this feels weird. You're letting us go even after the train thing?

060f242.speaker: Apoco
060f242.line: Oh, wow, a train crash. Scary.

0d5d2f4.speaker: Poco
0d5d2f4.line: A train crash that you two probably died in.

0ed3ad3.speaker: Poco
0ed3ad3.line: Think of this as a fresh start.

0ba94ba.speaker: Apoco
0ba94ba.line: It's a generous offer. You should take it.

0d64c70.speaker: Poco
0d64c70.line: Or you could try to make trouble. Seriously, it doesn't matter what you do next.

01dce5b.speaker: Apoco
01dce5b.line: Like, yeah, sure, go get beaten up by the local cops.

00b05c2.speaker: Poco
00b05c2.line: The needle will stay ever still.

0deb25c.speaker: Poco
0deb25c.line: So again, no. You don't scare us.

0524754.speaker: Poco
0524754.line: You have to be important to be scary.

0d66fd3.speaker: Quaver
0d66fd3.line: I was basically done, anyway. Just noodles and broth left.

03f244e.speaker: Unknown
03f244e.line: Noodles are the most important part.

01c0d35.speaker: Beat
01c0d35.line: It's not ramen without, well, ramen.

07d3ad9.speaker: Unknown
07d3ad9.line: Being done doesn't mean it wasn't good.

05d25f7.speaker: Poco
05d25f7.line: I didn't think you'd actually go get beaten up by the local cops.

0e03321.speaker: Poco
0e03321.line: Couldn't make that out, could you speak up?

0934166.speaker: Apoco
0934166.line: What happened to not making trouble?

0f0ea5e.speaker: Poco
0f0ea5e.line: Besides, what did we have to do with this?

07edb0c.speaker: Poco
07edb0c.line: Do you think we're really in charge of those guys?

0b797cd.speaker: Apoco
0b797cd.line: We don't tell them what to do.

0642f02.speaker: Poco
0642f02.line: Hell, we don't even tell their boss what to do.

0fef57a.speaker: Poco
0fef57a.line: Weird that you go around making friends with children.

0b4a2a9.speaker: Beat
0b4a2a9.line: You expect me to believe this was an accident

0d6b02d.speaker: Poco
0d6b02d.line: Do you think so little of the police that you assume they can't do things on their own?

06691be.speaker: Apoco
06691be.line: Though I do agree they're not too bright.

0a3ae01.speaker: Beat
0a3ae01.line: What the hell do you want with that, anyway?

016a486.speaker: Poco
016a486.line: What do you want with it?

057efff.speaker: Poco
057efff.line: We actually know what this photo means.

084e5b7.speaker: Beat
084e5b7.line: So do I, it's from Quaver's-

0562084.speaker: Poco
0562084.line: Yeah, the girl loves her mommy soooooo much!

0b46fe5.speaker: Apoco
0b46fe5.line: "Mommy" is such a fun word, isn't it?

0315124.speaker: Apoco
0315124.line: You know what I think about a lot?

0d90693.speaker: Apoco
0d90693.line: You don't write a press release for the people who read it.

00bc6d4.speaker: Poco
00bc6d4.line: Oh, true. You do think about this one a lot.

0fe09ba.speaker: Apoco
0fe09ba.line: Ball up the idea until it can't be taken apart.

022c339.speaker: Poco
022c339.line: People always assume that saying a lot of words means you're saying a lot.

0d050db.speaker: Apoco
0d050db.line: But most people saying a lot aren't really saying anything.

0a3e2b2.speaker: Apoco
0a3e2b2.line: Most people are just being loud for no reason.

0d98e6a.speaker: Beat
0d98e6a.line: She's not even going to be there.

07549f1.speaker: Brianna
07549f1.line: Well, we need to do it.

0b5a037.speaker: Brianna
0b5a037.line: Would you be like this if we were doing this in ten years?

07f5917.speaker: Brianna
07f5917.line: ...you and I can't fight like this anymore.

00f101f.speaker: ClefInside
00f101f.line: And don't LOOK at me like that.

0d1d1a3.speaker: ClefInside
0d1d1a3.line: ...thanks for getting us of jail, or whatever.

0b0d47d.speaker: ClefInside
0b0d47d.line: But we've got to be good to us right now.

0f754c1.speaker: Treble
0f754c1.line: given this response, i think you probably heard what the hell.

069f6d2.speaker: Clef
069f6d2.line: Exactly. And she needs someone to be a goddamn adult.

09c1e6d.speaker: Treble
09c1e6d.line: we're not just gonna disappear. we need to get ourselves together first.

0af5f2b.speaker: Treble
0af5f2b.line: but. right after that, we're probably out of here.

0396319.speaker: Treble
0396319.line: i think she needs it, you know?

0941bf3.speaker: Treble
0941bf3.line: she's been doing this for too long.

0fad2e3.speaker: Poco
0fad2e3.line: Oh, the mommy's girl and her adult friend.

0e71792.speaker: Apoco
0e71792.line: Have you been punched enough today, pink?

0b9a729.speaker: Poco
0b9a729.line: You can always be hit harder.

062dca8.speaker: Apoco
062dca8.line: Shut up, not you. The little girl.

0ddef5d.speaker: Poco
0ddef5d.line: Little girl, we're talking to you.

03b16c0.speaker: Apoco
03b16c0.line: She seems a bit confused, Poco.

0338360.speaker: Apoco
0338360.line: Do you know what this is?

0cd4081.speaker: Quaver
0cd4081.line: I've never seen that picture before.

0a79e8e.speaker: Apoco
0a79e8e.line: They look so happy, don't they?

00c9941.speaker: Quaver
00c9941.line: Where did you get that photo?

042b052.speaker: Apoco
042b052.line: Actually, you know what? On second thought, I think we're done here.

0e6ae0e.speaker: Apoco
0e6ae0e.line: Like we said. Keep making trouble if you feel like it.

09302a4.speaker: Quaver
09302a4.line: How did they even get that?

096a106.speaker: Beat
096a106.line: And screw Treble and Clef, too.

0624e89.speaker: Beat
0624e89.line: They say we can't do anything.

039f192.speaker: Quaver
039f192.line: You're not my mom, you know.

0f5bdbd.speaker: Quaver
0f5bdbd.line: I'm a bit better, I guess.

0b711a7.speaker: Quaver
0b711a7.line: I haven't seen Treble or Clef, no.

06c04a7.speaker: Quaver
06c04a7.line: Did you want to chase them down?

0002329.speaker: Treble
0002329.line: ...and it's not your fault. and it's not fair. but you have to do it if you want it.

0cd7f40.speaker: Treble
0cd7f40.line: see, like now. that's what i'm saying.

0b8ea09.speaker: Treble
0b8ea09.line: beat, you don't pay enough attention.

0496d45.speaker: Treble
0496d45.line: perfect example: you've been running around with quaver taking all those photos, right.

045fba7.speaker: Treble
045fba7.line: this was literally one of those. did you even catch that?

076f407.speaker: Treble
076f407.line: you should check this place out.

09e2908.speaker: Beat
09e2908.line: ...I didn't even know you noticed that.

0894f7d.speaker: Treble
0894f7d.line: i don't say a lot of things.

01566be.speaker: Treble
01566be.line: which is probably weird because i do also, uh, say a lot of things.

0aad750.speaker: Treble
0aad750.line: so you can imagine that i'm very careful about the stuff i don't.

07c31e6.speaker: Beat
07c31e6.line: Ugh. Thanks. I'll chase it down.

069c09a.speaker: Treble
069c09a.line: you're not really all that patient, are you?

0ef00c3.speaker: Treble
0ef00c3.line: she might not really want to be found, you know.

0f124ee.speaker: Treble
0f124ee.line: sure. how were you at twelve?

090b25a.speaker: Treble
090b25a.line: anyway. i notice a lot of things, that's all.

078367e.speaker: Treble
078367e.line: i gotta get back to clef.

0044760.speaker: Treble
0044760.line: oh. one last thing. don't pay attention to the twins.

06f4b79.speaker: Treble
06f4b79.line: hard not to. they practically radiate theme music

0ccebef.speaker: Treble
0ccebef.line: or they would if their whole thing wasn't, well. hehe. yeah.

0b604a0.speaker: Treble
0b604a0.line: they will goad the shit out of you. don't let them.

0c13b39.speaker: Treble
0c13b39.line: they are very good at reading people at a glance.

022bdbe.speaker: Treble
022bdbe.line: you can't stop them reading you, but don't let them write new pages.

0700027.speaker: Clef
0700027.line: Me and Treb have been at this on our own forever.

01cdb0d.speaker: Clef
01cdb0d.line: This shit is.. it's in us.

01c5536.speaker: Clef
01c5536.line: In a way that you don't get out of you.

000857e.speaker: Clef
000857e.line: You can't get it out of you. Even if you wanted to.

09b3ce7.speaker: Clef
09b3ce7.line: And of course you don't want to. That would be insane.

0a42868.speaker: Clef
0a42868.line: Because if we're being honest with ourselves, music, is, like...

017da47.speaker: Clef
017da47.line: It's the closest thing we can get to there being proof that god exists.

016900d.speaker: Clef
016900d.line: I know you know what I'm talking about.

0f9835d.speaker: Clef
0f9835d.line: But Treble lost his goddamned arm, Beat.

02d2343.speaker: Clef
02d2343.line: We got nothing else going on.

0208fe6.speaker: Clef
0208fe6.line: We got no money. No friends.

0aaef4a.speaker: Clef
0aaef4a.line: We don't have anyone except for each other.

0088aec.speaker: Clef
0088aec.line: Really, though, shut up until I'm done.

0f6aeab.speaker: Clef
0f6aeab.line: Not even in a mean way. I just. I need to say this.

0b296df.speaker: Clef
0b296df.line: You're a very good songwriter and a very good singer.

0191adc.speaker: Clef
0191adc.line: And I think if you actually took the time to write something with us in mind,

01c4c6b.speaker: Clef
01c4c6b.line: and all of us practiced, and didn't half-ass it, and we got it down...

04f4d57.speaker: Clef
04f4d57.line: There might, really, actually, be something here.

0d04331.speaker: Clef
0d04331.line: I don't know where it goes. Where CAN any of it go, when...

0b7c2f5.speaker: Clef
0b7c2f5.line: The goddamn all of it, right now, there's no way to live doing this.

0251449.speaker: Clef
0251449.line: They took that away from us.

029e5c8.speaker: Clef
029e5c8.line: But for some reason part of all of us wants to do this.

0fdeee9.speaker: Clef
0fdeee9.line: And, anyway, it's all you've got. Frankly, it's all I've got.

01aea76.speaker: Clef
01aea76.line: If Treble and I leave, we'll just end up miserable.

0026bc5.speaker: Clef
0026bc5.line: And he knows it and he thinks I don't know he knows I know it.

0fb7da4.speaker: Clef
0fb7da4.line: No blaze of glory. No more cops. On our own, we're done.

0e6c28a.speaker: Clef
0e6c28a.line: Quaver, as annoying as it is sometimes, definitely isn't tired yet.

059a712.speaker: Clef
059a712.line: And maybe with you two pulling us along, we might...

01e4be6.speaker: Clef
01e4be6.line: Maybe something comes back to us. Maybe we get it back.

0d2f073.speaker: Clef
0d2f073.line: ...You can talk now, if you want.

0d14753.speaker: Quaver
0d14753.line: I think she's worried about the same thing I am.

03a9f4d.speaker: Quaver
03a9f4d.line: It's great if we can actually figure out how to be a band, as a band, but...

07f971e.speaker: Quaver
07f971e.line: ...We can't keep it hidden for too long.

0e25678.speaker: Quaver
0e25678.line: And even if we could, what would the point be if we can't get people to watch?

0a2d977.speaker: Clef
0a2d977.line: Oh, that's not a problem. I've got that part locked down.

06de8f1.speaker: Quaver
06de8f1.line: So, then, there is a way to do this more discreetly.

0a638d4.speaker: Clef
0a638d4.line: No no no no no no no no no.

0c45135.speaker: Clef
0c45135.line: We need to go as loud as possible.

01d5b37.speaker: Penny
01d5b37.line: I don't know what you're talking about!

06062a2.speaker: Cop
06062a2.line: Are you really disrespecting an officer of the law?

0719a60.speaker: Treble
0719a60.line: sorry if we got you into trouble.

0797110.speaker: Penny
0797110.line: Oh, woof. Let me know if it ever happens again.

08984e5.speaker: Penny
08984e5.line: Might as well see what I got in trouble for.

0909acf.speaker: Treble
0909acf.line: you know how much work it takes to get clef to open up?

0152619.speaker: Treble
0152619.line: and i get that you're going through a hard time right now...

0cd9257.speaker: Treble
0cd9257.line: but you have to be a person.

080ab91.speaker: Treble
080ab91.line: i prove it every day i'm alive.

0f122c5.speaker: Beat
0f122c5.line: I'm a piece of shit, Treble.

062c71e.speaker: Treble
062c71e.line: you try too hard for that.

0d987bf.speaker: Treble
0d987bf.line: i can't offer much besides words,

0e19a87.speaker: Treble
0e19a87.line: and the words can't be much besides "trust me,"

002dce7.speaker: Treble
002dce7.line: ...and you have got to stop moping.

0925d05.speaker: Treble
0925d05.line: i did my best to make clef hear you out.

089ee55.speaker: Treble
089ee55.line: but you have to have something worth hearing.

09ce0f0.speaker: Treble
09ce0f0.line: and, you know what? she does.

0830843.speaker: Treble
0830843.line: i'm saying it so you know it's true.

0d18e35.speaker: Treble
0d18e35.line: just. come with me. i'll let her do the talking.

0755abb.speaker: Quaver
0755abb.line: Did we put the right time on the...

037f14d.speaker: Beat
037f14d.line: I'm pretty sure we did, Quaver.

0bec01f.speaker: Quaver
0bec01f.line: ...what's the point of this if nobody's even here?

080b646.speaker: Beat
080b646.line: You can still do a show, uh...

09b431b.speaker: Unknown
09b431b.line: I mean, maybe we can just play by ourselves?

02ae269.speaker: Beat
02ae269.line: Besides, people might come in late.

0c4a123.speaker: Beat
0c4a123.line: I hear you, you hear me, right?

09c9349.speaker: Beat
09c9349.line: We should do what we came here to do, right?

097e30d.speaker: Poco
097e30d.line: Wow. Look at that. I'd slow clap but I don't want to risk seeming sincere.

0ef7278.speaker: Poco
0ef7278.line: I'm actually a little surprised you tried at all.

05c9d27.speaker: Poco
05c9d27.line: We won, guys. Pack it in.

0542e0f.speaker: Apoco
0542e0f.line: Tell them the thing you like to say, sis.

0840ecf.speaker: Poco
0840ecf.line: Apoco, I say a lot of things.

07e073a.speaker: Poco
07e073a.line: Gladiator fight, chariot races, all that.

08c9538.speaker: Poco
08c9538.line: It all just one real rule, if you drill down.

0be4401.speaker: Poco
0be4401.line: Do you want to guess what that rule is?

0193221.speaker: Poco
0193221.line: See, the emperor was always watching the fights. That was the real point.

04236cb.speaker: Poco
04236cb.line: They were all just entertainment for the big guy.

0c9e140.speaker: Poco
0c9e140.line: If you lost a fight, the other guy wouldn't finish you off right away.

002c330.speaker: Poco
002c330.line: Instead, he'd pause, and look up-

04d7467.speaker: Poco
04d7467.line: Right. And the emperor would give a signal.

0435c3f.speaker: Poco
0435c3f.line: And if he liked the guy who lost, he'd give a thumbs up.

0d2ab85.speaker: Poco
0d2ab85.line: And the loser would be spared.

0a00e40.speaker: Poco
0a00e40.line: Well, you can do the math.

03c7a0d.speaker: Poco
03c7a0d.line: So, really, the only rule was don't be boring.

07ef1cf.speaker: Poco
07ef1cf.line: Here's the dirty secret of modern life: that's still true.

09474a2.speaker: Apoco
09474a2.line: If you're boring, you might as well be dead.

0a067c8.speaker: Poco
0a067c8.line: We still operate on gladiatorial rules.

0de1959.speaker: Poco
0de1959.line: The only thing that's changed is the emperors we have to perform for.

022c4f1.speaker: Poco
022c4f1.line: Do yourself a favor. Give up and save us the trouble.

0094679.speaker: Apoco
0094679.line: We're burning so much MONEY keeping staff quiet about us finding you guys.

0bc7808.speaker: Poco
0bc7808.line: We can't do it for long.

0159b8d.speaker: Poco
0159b8d.line: So just fade into the background. Both of you.

06157ed.speaker: Poco
06157ed.line: It's what you're already good at.

0b64384.speaker: Clef
0b64384.line: You can't let them get the last word.

01db57f.speaker: Beat
01db57f.line: Yeah, and I keep screwing that up.

032fc43.speaker: Clef
032fc43.line: You're gonna make me say it, aren't you.

04b7ba8.speaker: Beat
04b7ba8.line: I don't even know what "it" is.

0d09540.speaker: Beat
0d09540.line: Fight. I'm too tired. I don't want to.

0d8b58b.speaker: Beat
0d8b58b.line: It's fine. It'll be fine. Just...

07a1ccd.speaker: Clef
07a1ccd.line: What the hell is this supposed to be?

01bc89c.speaker: Clef
01bc89c.line: It's caveman-brain obvious what you're doing, dipshit.

0a94068.speaker: Clef
0a94068.line: You're gonna get yourselves killed. This is stupid!

0ad0de7.speaker: Clef
0ad0de7.line: I get the fricken' hint. I'll go where I'm wanted. Bye.

05923ce.speaker: Quaver
05923ce.line: Are you done with your poster?

0424ae3.speaker: Nierbox
0424ae3.line: >That look on your face... it's strange.

0803e8a.speaker: Nierbox
0803e8a.line: >Don't get me wrong. It's kind of nice to see you like this.

017aaa2.speaker: Nierbox
017aaa2.line: >Or it would be in other circumstances.

0933a08.speaker: Nierbox
0933a08.line: >It's honestly what I admire about you.

00408ec.speaker: Nierbox
00408ec.line: >I hope that doesn't change after all of this.

023b24f.speaker: Nierbox
023b24f.line: >You know I'm very proud of you, right?

09d0948.speaker: Nierbox
09d0948.line: >But I'm very, very proud of you.

0fef611.speaker: Nierbox
0fef611.line: >And you're going to do amazing things.

07af746.speaker: Nierbox
07af746.line: >Mom was way better at this kind of stuff than I am.

00fcf03.speaker: Nierbox
00fcf03.line: >The other day, I was talking to a friend of ours...

0d36da2.speaker: Nierbox
0d36da2.line: >Well..."friend." Asshole. Told me eventually I would stop missing her.

0638cab.speaker: Nierbox
0638cab.line: >That's wrong, though. It's that weird streak of fatalism about this shit,

0a0e919.speaker: Nierbox
0a0e919.line: >where people say nothing matters because the universe will just end.

04c3479.speaker: Nierbox
04c3479.line: >It won't end right now. We aren't living at the heat death of the universe.

03c7928.speaker: Nierbox
03c7928.line: >Maybe by then we'll figure out some new way forward.

0f67eae.speaker: Beat
0f67eae.line: Well I bet you this does something.

03b2483.speaker: Beat
03b2483.line: Or at least it's not gonna be bad to take it with us.

0221de5.speaker: Quaver
0221de5.line: I wonder why this is even here.

046fd7e.speaker: Beat
046fd7e.line: Shh. Stop mouthlooking the gift horse.

020ec77.speaker: Quaver
020ec77.line: That's another expression I don't really get.

0a61728.speaker: Beat
0a61728.line: There are so many cop posters around here.

0d5a074.speaker: Beat
0d5a074.line: And they're an eyesore to boot.

065126f.speaker: Beat
065126f.line: Why does it feel like we keep running towards problems instead of away from them?

09980af.speaker: Clef
09980af.line: We won't be if we don't eat something soon.

07d88cc.speaker: Treble
07d88cc.line: we can once we get somewhere that isn't a, uh, pipe.

08921c6.speaker: Quaver
08921c6.line: If we walk just a little bit further...

0842812.speaker: Quaver
0842812.line: I think we're pretty close to where the next train stop was?

096e59a.speaker: Quaver
096e59a.line: But regardless of where we are, we should keep moving.

03b7f12.speaker: Quaver
03b7f12.line: HARM agents are definitely doing a radial sweep by now.

0398967.speaker: Clef
0398967.line: Whatever. Why do you know this shit? How do you know this shit?

0ca3277.speaker: Quaver
0ca3277.line: Uh, I'm twelve and a half.

06bc613.speaker: Clef
06bc613.line: And you got a goddamn college degree in that year difference?

0cb1572.speaker: Clef
0cb1572.line: We're fine. How's everyone's instruments doing? My drumkit took a saltwater bath.

0b22fae.speaker: Clef
0b22fae.line: What? We floated by a beach. Beach is salty.

0a373eb.speaker: Treble
0a373eb.line: drink the sewage to confirm, then.

0148f26.speaker: Beat
0148f26.line: There were a lot of squad cars.

0e82b55.speaker: Treble
0e82b55.line: like a dealership made of ham

0e8a5b2.speaker: Beat
0e8a5b2.line: They're probably gonna roll out at a moment's notice.

0880687.speaker: Beat
0880687.line: I think the van you all stole came from here.

0b2e17c.speaker: Quaver
0b2e17c.line: Which means they're definitely unloading contraband, right?

0940733.speaker: Treble
0940733.line: all contraband is fun, beat. that's why it's contraband.

0cf8cff.speaker: Clef
0cf8cff.line: Come on. What else did you find?

0b7f407.speaker: Beat
0b7f407.line: ...oh my god, the cop station is shit-powered.

07bbc3c.speaker: Beat
07bbc3c.line: Think about it, why else would there be the whole weird sewer reupholster?

00bd507.speaker: Quaver
00bd507.line: I wouldn't call what was in the sewer upholstery.

0234666.speaker: Beat
0234666.line: Whatever, whatever. My point is that those pipes have a purpose.

0ceaa9c.speaker: Beat
0ceaa9c.line: This whole place is drawing tons of power.

0a889b0.speaker: Beat
0a889b0.line: I bet you part of that power is hydroelectric.

09d1a91.speaker: Beat
09d1a91.line: The bad thing is that I don't think we can totally shut the place down.

00384c8.speaker: Quaver
00384c8.line: Yeah, but a breaker trip would still be something.

0362911.speaker: Beat
0362911.line: Yeah, they've got these security cameras allllll the way around.

0430269.speaker: Quaver
0430269.line: ...We're pretty sure any ground routes are completely cut off.

005d740.speaker: Treble
005d740.line: yeah. they'd jump us the moment they matched our faces to the posters.

008c0db.speaker: Quaver
008c0db.line: They'd jump us the moment we were anybody.

04a5b19.speaker: Quaver
04a5b19.line: They do not want people here!

0d7e5e4.speaker: Beat
0d7e5e4.line: Which kills a bit of the momentum of being the feet.

0b4885a.speaker: Quaver
0b4885a.line: But there's a big obvious blindspot between them.

0a3633c.speaker: Beat
0a3633c.line: Yeah, I mean, that's because you'd have to be stupid to do it.

082ec4b.speaker: Clef
082ec4b.line: So. I think we're back to the window.

003949a.speaker: Clef
003949a.line: No. I believe in you, and... etcetera.

0333eb3.speaker: Quaver
0333eb3.line: We've still got more photos to get through!

017aeb3.speaker: Quaver
017aeb3.line: Yeah, it's basically just a big camera.

0b93384.speaker: Beat
0b93384.line: So getting in close will be a problem.

02e692a.speaker: Clef
02e692a.line: It's like if you have huge boobs and you try to look at your feet.

061761c.speaker: Clef
061761c.line: And the building is like... the boobs...

0468731.speaker: Clef
0468731.line: So... we could be the feet.

0823829.speaker: Treble
0823829.line: it is making me miserable that i can't poke holes in that

047d23c.speaker: Quaver
047d23c.line: You're right. It's got a massive vision cone, but that cone is worthless if you're ground level.

01fbd8a.speaker: Beat
01fbd8a.line: It's uh, a little high up, isn't it?

01918b3.speaker: Beat
01918b3.line: How the hell do you want me to get up there?

0b0ae64.speaker: Treble
0b0ae64.line: unless you want to deal with literally all of the cops.

028dee0.speaker: Beat
028dee0.line: There has to be an easier way to get inside.

03e7451.speaker: Quaver
03e7451.line: There's an issue with that, anyway...

03ff012.speaker: Rest
03ff012.line: Most of this I already know.

0a065ac.speaker: Rest
0a065ac.line: What I don't know is either irrelevant...

0ae1104.speaker: Rest
0ae1104.line: And...we barely have anything on her.

038dbb1.speaker: Apoco
038dbb1.line: Our team is pretty sure we know where they're all going.

02b2efd.speaker: Rest
02b2efd.line: What is this leading up to?

083151c.speaker: Rest
083151c.line: Do you have a plan in mind?

00d0f42.speaker: Rest
00d0f42.line: I can see you listening, you know.

090eec2.speaker: Rest
090eec2.line: You have better things to worry about than spying on me.

00f04aa.speaker: Rest
00f04aa.line: I can only assume you're doing something in your office all day.

0d31aa6.speaker: Sforzando
0d31aa6.line: I haven't stopped bringing money in, if that's what you're worried about.

03fa146.speaker: Sforzando
03fa146.line: A sense of humor? From you?

0feaa70.speaker: Rest
0feaa70.line: That would mean there was something to laugh at.

0d14472.speaker: Rest
0d14472.line: I said "dismissed." Was that not clear enough?

0bb0606.speaker: Poco
0bb0606.line: You need to live up to your name a bit more.

09ff57a.speaker: Poco
09ff57a.line: Come on, hit the beach once in a while.

02f7e5c.speaker: Quaver
02f7e5c.line: ...mind if I hop away for a second?

03cdd06.speaker: Quaver
03cdd06.line: And, you know, thanks for all the, uh, trying.

0a10dc3.speaker: Quaver
0a10dc3.line: I really do appreciate it, you know.

0f82a0f.speaker: Beat
0f82a0f.line: Well, you finished before me, so you might as well go first.

0e83c7d.speaker: Quaver
0e83c7d.line: Now that I actually have to show it off, I'm...

0bdfe51.speaker: Quaver
0bdfe51.line: I've never done anything like this before and I'm worried I might have messed it up...

019062c.speaker: Beat
019062c.line: We don't have all day. Just go for it.

09d2731.speaker: Rest
09d2731.line: This has been an absolute clusterbomb of bullshit.

01e2faa.speaker: Rest
01e2faa.line: I hope you have some kind of good news?

0d5d26d.speaker: Apoco
0d5d26d.line: Good news really isn't the thing we do.

0864cd1.speaker: Poco
0864cd1.line: I mean, we do do news good.

0b60014.speaker: Apoco
0b60014.line: But, still, yes, actually. Kind of.

0e97215.speaker: Apoco
0e97215.line: A team working with our direction.

09b35bf.speaker: Poco
09b35bf.line: Full dossiers on our special four.

0d0b9ae.speaker: Rest
0d0b9ae.line: They're not working with anyone else?

0a5d31d.speaker: Rest
0a5d31d.line: You realize how spectacularly embarassing this is for us, right?

095a9c5.speaker: Rest
095a9c5.line: I don't have to tell you?

0f5bd21.speaker: Poco
0f5bd21.line: If we do our jobs correctly...

045b172.speaker: Poco
045b172.line: Because we do our jobs correctly, it isn't embarassing.

0d45daf.speaker: Rest
0d45daf.line: ...mitigation isn't a solve. No amount of spin can fix a flat tire.

0a48375.speaker: Rest
0a48375.line: Ugh. Walk me through the reports. Maybe fresh eyes will help.

014939c.line: Okay, so think of it this way.

07abc0b.speaker: Clef
07abc0b.line: Cops around here don't have anything to do because nobody does ANYTHING.

0a8af32.speaker: Treble
0a8af32.line: it's basically a town filled with people waiting to die.

079fdf0.speaker: Clef
079fdf0.line: So they're bored, which makes them dangerous.

0ce4f38.speaker: Clef
0ce4f38.line: They'll come sprinting in seconds if they so much as hear a bird sing.

02ab6fd.speaker: Treble
02ab6fd.line: i have seen them do it.

08497a9.speaker: Quaver
08497a9.line: And we're putting on a concert, which is maybe the most illegal thing there is.

019d0c9.speaker: Treble
019d0c9.line: murder is the most illegal thing there is. this is more like...

0209a9a.speaker: Clef
0209a9a.line: Somewhere between arson and a bank heist.

029fd7c.speaker: Beat
029fd7c.line: Can you make the cops not notice a bank heist?

018293a.speaker: Clef
018293a.line: You can't. That's the FUN part.

0c8f8be.speaker: Clef
0c8f8be.line: See, if bored cops will jump at the chance to investigate any small crisis that comes their way...

02b826e.speaker: Clef
02b826e.line: What will they do if every crisis comes their way?

01c55a0.speaker: Clef
01c55a0.line: Then yes. Lots of it, too.

0bd5b63.speaker: Clef
0bd5b63.line: This is a map of the area, right?

0d20ad5.speaker: Treble
0d20ad5.line: she stole that from a library book

03003d3.speaker: Clef
03003d3.line: If we hit the station, we'll draw the one or two guys around here like moths to-

0aaccff.speaker: Quaver
0aaccff.line: Not that. And your basic premise is fine.

08f5681.speaker: Quaver
08f5681.line: But you're looking at the thing they'd want you looking at.

0f61670.speaker: Quaver
0f61670.line: There's all these signs that HARM is everywhere here, right?

085ade0.speaker: Quaver
085ade0.line: And yet have you seen a single HARM agent since we got in town?

0bca8f1.speaker: Quaver
0bca8f1.line: Besides the Poco twins, of course. And not regular cops.

0a18da8.speaker: Quaver
0a18da8.line: Here, on the map, you see this?

01dfbda.speaker: Quaver
01dfbda.line: Is there anything else on the map with nothing there?

0b7101e.speaker: Quaver
0b7101e.line: And police gates are guarding the only two roads leading there.

0e27979.speaker: Quaver
0e27979.line: I know a little bit about HARM sites.

0be97f6.speaker: Quaver
0be97f6.line: There are tons back in the heart of the city.

04c7d90.speaker: Quaver
04c7d90.line: If they built one out here, this is where they'd put it.

0ff7ca0.speaker: Quaver
0ff7ca0.line: You want to draw moths to a flame? Use a flamethrower.

01b74ad.speaker: Clef
01b74ad.line: Are you sure you two are good to scope the place out?

0909806.speaker: Clef
0909806.line: Last time, I mean, you ended up in prison. With us.

065b020.speaker: Beat
065b020.line: It has to be us. Quaver's obviously the one who knows the most about how these sites work.

08d2207.speaker: Beat
08d2207.line: But, also, we're not gonna just send her off by herself.

037d60c.speaker: Quaver
037d60c.line: I could do it all alone.

02febd6.speaker: Clef
02febd6.line: We can kinda fake an MO here since we've already stolen a police van.

02ba81c.speaker: Clef
02ba81c.line: We'll let them know it's us.

0238238.speaker: Clef
0238238.line: Steal some contraband, steal a vehicle...

09aecb9.speaker: Clef
09aecb9.line: I'll be right behind you to help out with the starting gun. Quaver, you're on-

0276b16.speaker: Clef
0276b16.line: Right. Treb, are you even helping?

04182bb.speaker: Clef
04182bb.line: I have no goddamn idea what you're talking about.

0654582.speaker: Treble
0654582.line: the boring stuff. the chores. don't worry about it.

0ef45a8.speaker: Beat
0ef45a8.line: How's everyone feel about how rehearsals went?

0e1e632.speaker: Quaver
0e1e632.line: Is that a good thing or a bad thing?

088d7b3.speaker: Beat
088d7b3.line: It's not good that the way out is blocked, Quaver.

09ff4fd.speaker: Quaver
09ff4fd.line: No, no. No, I mean, uh. The thing you said.

075f922.speaker: Beat
075f922.line: You've never heard that before? Seriously?

0666ef1.speaker: Quaver
0666ef1.line: But I've...I never really understood it?

050e0ff.speaker: Quaver
050e0ff.line: And I've... been too afraid to ask.

01f13d9.speaker: Beat
01f13d9.line: It's just a sarcastic way to say "that's obvious."

063d650.speaker: Quaver
063d650.line: No, I sort of know that...sort of. Literally, I know what it means...

01c3f52.speaker: Quaver
01c3f52.line: But I guess... what I'm asking, is... is, is it an insult, or are you agreeing-

02d8de4.speaker: Beat
02d8de4.line: I don't even know how to unpack that.

004333a.speaker: Beat
004333a.line: But I for one meant it as sort of an extreme agreement with you?

0d13c3b.speaker: Beat
0d13c3b.line: You could also say it in a way that was an insult.

0737767.speaker: Treble
0737767.line: hey, so, uh, one sec. team meeting?

021eb1f.speaker: Treble
021eb1f.line: the point of order: this place is a maze.

0f06696.speaker: Treble
0f06696.line: it'd be good if some of us could anchor ourselves in one place?

09966eb.speaker: Treble
09966eb.line: that way, if the rest get lost, they could shout back?

05c7cd6.speaker: Clef
05c7cd6.line: Given the state of us, I'm wondering how much I value that.

01a0890.speaker: Clef
01a0890.line: It doesn't help that I'm hungry.

0b45df2.speaker: Treble
0b45df2.line: then get something out of the fridge

07964de.speaker: Beat
07964de.line: I knew what the rest of the conversation was ten minutes before it ended.

0f45216.speaker: Beat
0f45216.line: I've heard it before from teachers.

05c9c91.speaker: Beat
05c9c91.line: From my sister's face before her mouth made a sound.

0267c45.speaker: Beat
0267c45.line: All in the shoulders and elbows and eyes.

0b829f4.speaker: Beat
0b829f4.line: I wish I remembered crying. I think refusing to is more embarassing in hindsight.

0a5b5cd.speaker: Beat
0a5b5cd.line: A little cleanup and it'll suck less.

0c97536.speaker: Beat
0c97536.line: Clef, you weren't actually serious, right?

0c345b0.speaker: Beat
0c345b0.line: This fridge is older than some of us here.

033910c.speaker: Quaver
033910c.line: We'll have to get the power on, though.

0e19b8a.speaker: Beat
0e19b8a.line: I think there was a generator outside?

0eb01f8.speaker: Quaver
0eb01f8.line: This was actually my parents' old shack.

0c68302.speaker: Treble
0c68302.line: this place smells like the inside of a used balloon.

02b1dcf.speaker: Beat
02b1dcf.line: This goes here, this goes here...

0078d2a.speaker: Beat
0078d2a.line: I wanna say "open sesame," but that doesn't make any sense.

0091e86.speaker: Beat
0091e86.line: This place couldn't get any more open...er.

0808480.speaker: Beat
0808480.line: Only so much a generator can fix.

0ffe044.speaker: Beat
0ffe044.line: Damn, I'm tired... I should get to bed.

0d8f8ef.speaker: Quaver
0d8f8ef.line: I'm shocked this is still here.

0959917.speaker: Quaver
0959917.line: But it's good! It gives us a place to lie low.

01dea2b.speaker: Beat
01dea2b.line: It sure is a place, at least.

0659240.speaker: Clef
0659240.line: It looks like tetanus in a box.

028b114.speaker: Clef
028b114.line: YES! THE PIPE IS FIXED. THANKS!

0a4def5.speaker: Beat
0a4def5.line: YOU HAVE TO USE THE TERMINAL

0775b31.speaker: Beat
0775b31.line: HERE. I'M GONNA THROW YOU THE CARD.

09f8e26.speaker: Beat
09f8e26.line: JUST CATCH THIS. YOU CAN TURN OFF THE SLUICE.

0c6c918.speaker: Clef
0c6c918.line: WHAT DO YOU WANT ME TO DO

0c26c6d.speaker: Treble
0c26c6d.line: i'll help her out don't worry

01dc0c0.speaker: Quaver
01dc0c0.line: Beat, I don't think that's the right way.

067a5b0.speaker: Quaver
067a5b0.line: I hope you aren't gonna think I'm bragging when I say this, but...

0d7c0a4.speaker: Quaver
0d7c0a4.line: ...I've got a good sense of direction and a good internal map, and-

0b86755.speaker: Beat
0b86755.line: It is bragging, but, go on.

0143ed8.speaker: Quaver
0143ed8.line: Aanndd, I've been pretty sure I know where we are until right now.

0667296.speaker: Quaver
0667296.line: We should be right by a small township on the city outskirts.

060f23f.speaker: Quaver
060f23f.line: The kind of place that has bad sewers because they don't have the money for good ones.

060114f.speaker: Quaver
060114f.line: And that? Looks expensive. Doesn't that worry you?

029420b.speaker: Beat
029420b.line: Besides, we should find the others.
